reason: Eight provider-chat turn lifecycle and subagent defects from the round-4 chat audit (findings 4, 5, 6, 7, 13, 15, 16, 17). A parent turn parked on wait_subagents whose automatic resume failed stayed WAITING_CALLBACK forever: _resume_waiting_parent now fails the turn visibly with the resume error and posts the finished reports so the operator can resend. A graceful Core stop recorded every in-flight provider turn as CANCELLED 'response stopped', so startup() recovery was unreachable after a deploy: both CancelledError handlers now honour shutting_down and park the turn INTERRUPTED with the same recovery snapshot startup() writes after a crash (unknown tool and hook outcomes flagged), skip the chat.turn.cancelled hook, and give followers an error frame instead of a cancelled one; _child_settled maps that to the existing 'Core shut down' subagent state. _persist_turn_inputs used the session revision read at the top of prepare_async, so any session write during preparation (naming task, subagent report, popup keepalive) failed the send with a raw 409; it now re-reads the session before each attempt and retries the guarded write up to three times, and its active-turn guard includes WAITING_CALLBACK like pending_turn. stop_provider_turn now delivers subagent reports that finished while the parent was parked instead of after the next reply. fork_session strips subagent_id, subagent_parent_* and temporary_assistant so a branch is neither a permanent subagent nor a hidden popup the sweeper deletes. follow_chat_turn.events() catches non-ChatError producer failures and emits the durable error frame instead of tearing the SSE stream. A subagent that fails to start now removes its never-run child conversation and record and returns the error inline, so no empty 'Subagent · …' chat is listed and no duplicate failure message is posted. Tests: test_core_shutdown_leaves_an_inflight_provider_turn_recoverable, test_persist_turn_inputs_retries_against_a_session_written_during_prepare, test_fork_drops_subagent_and_temporary_markers and test_persist_turn_inputs_refuses_a_waiting_callback_turn in test_chat.py; test_follow_reports_a_turn_that_failed_outside_chat_errors_as_an_error_frame in test_chat_api.py; test_failed_parent_resume_fails_the_turn_and_posts_reports, test_stopping_an_interrupted_parent_posts_finished_reports, test_core_shutdown_interrupts_an_inflight_parent_tool_turn and test_subagent_start_failure_leaves_no_child_conversation_or_duplicate_report in test_chat_subagents.py. All nine fail on origin/main. test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_chat_reconnection.py and test_temporary_chat.py are included as regression coverage for the tool-loop cancel handler, the follow endpoint and the fork/temporary markers.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through tests/v3/test_chat.py, tests/v3/test_chat_api.py, tests/v3/test_chat_subagents.py, tests/v3/test_chat_tool_loop.py, tests/v3/test_chat_reconnection.py and tests/v3/test_temporary_chat.py) does not exercise Core shutdown, subagent resume failure, stale-session persistence or torn follower streams; the Python tests drive them directly. No full suites.
